") a mental health care company focused on innovative behavioral health treatments with a focus on safe, evidence-based psychedelic-assisted therapies, today announced that it has filed all quarterly interim financial reports for fiscal year 2026 to May 31, 2026.

With the recent completion of the August 31, 2025, audit, together with the filings of the Company's outstanding interim financial reports for fiscal year 2026, the Company is positioned to satisfy the regulatory requirements necessary for the British Columbia Securities Commission (the "BCSC") to have the current cease trade order (the "CTO") with respect to the Company revoked.

Concurrently, management shall continue with its previously announced application to list its common shares on the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "CSE"). Successfully executing these steps remains management's primary strategy to restore trading, enhance shareholder liquidity, and position the Company for its next phase of growth. A listing on the CSE will be contingent on the Company satisfying the CSE's listing requirements and being approved for the listing on that exchange
Revenue of $4.5 million for the period ending Q3 2026
Gross profit of $0.9M compared to a gross profit of $0.9 million in Q2 2026
Gross margin of 54.4% compared to a gross margin of 55.9% during Q2 2026
Cash position of $0.5 million as of May 31, 2026
Profit of $0.8 million in the Company's Practitioner Training segment as of Q3 2026
Results from Continuing Operations for Q3 Fiscal 2026
Consolidated revenue was substantially unchanged quarter over quarter, decreasing 0.5% from Q2 2026.
Revenue from Cedar Clinical Research ("CCR") increased 29.0%, from $0.9 million in Q2 2026 to $1.2 million in Q3 2026, reflecting a recovery from seasonal variation in clinical trial patient visits.

Revenue from Practitioner Training decreased from $0.7 million in Q2 2026 to $0.4 million in Q3 2026. The decrease reflects the number of participants trained in the period under existing training contracts rather than a reduction in contracted work.
The Practitioner Training segment recorded segment profit of $0.8 million for the nine months ended May 31, 2026 and has been profitable in each quarter since August 31, 2025.
Numinus ended the quarter with cash and cash equivalents of $0.5 million and a working capital deficiency of $3.8 million.

Numinus Wellness Inc. (OTC Pink: NUMIF) helps people to heal and be well through the development and delivery of innovative mental health care and access to safe, evidence-based psychedelic-assisted therapies. The Numinus model - including psychedelic research and training - is at the forefront of a transformation aimed at healing rather than managing symptoms for depression, anxiety, trauma, pain and substance use. At Numinus, we are leading the integration of psychedelic-assisted therapies into mainstream clinical practice and building the foundation for a healthier society.
Learn more at www.numinusnetwork.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram.
